newsitem.title: USA: Forum plans to suspend distributions.
newsitem.headline: Forum plans to suspend distributions.

text.p: Forum Retirement Partners LP said on Monday that it does not expect to make distributions to limited partner units for the foreseeable future, since the company needs more capital for its expansion plan.
The company said it intends to fund an expansion from its cash flow from operations.
However, if the cash flow is insufficient to complete the expansion on a timely basis, the expansion may be delayed, reduced in scope or discontinued, Forum Retirement said.
Forum said it has completed four projects in its expansion plan, five projects are under construction and another five projects are under development or design.
The 10 projects under construction or development are expected to increase the number of living and nursing units owned by the partnership by approximately 18 percent, Forum said.
Four of the five projects under development or design are expected to begin construction by the end of 1997, Forum said.

The expansion program is designed to modify uses of or add capacity to existing facilities without incurring substantial land acquisition costs, Forum said. Certain expansions depend upon regulatory approval, the company said.
Forum, a limited partnership, presently has nine properties with a total of 1,669 residential units.
The last time Forum had paid a distribution to unitholders was six years ago, Forum said.
